Definition: from the same as G224; to grind:--grind.
BiblicalUsage: Twice, in the same saying on two lips. Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left. The word is the daily grind, the women's work at the millstone, and Jesus sets the suddenness of His coming against it — ordinary work, and then the separation.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for grinding grain carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the scene it is set in, that the day of the Lord comes on an ordinary working morning and finds two at the same mill.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
